payload.body_they: {{Name}} notices changes in a partner's mood quickly and may start adjusting their own plans before either person has said what is actually needed. Care is one of the ways they build closeness, but being good at noticing does not make them responsible for noticing everything first. A relationship becomes more dependable when both people can name what they need and neither person's feelings automatically become the other person's job.
